first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4%, both reversals from earlier documented wins. Memory_91 shows in-product activation messaging drove week-one engagement and first meaningful action, directly targeting the current activation decline. Memory_86 showed onboarding simplification improved completion and adoption. Rather than respond to competitor pricing with promotional_pricing (memory_73 explicitly warns of 30-day retention harm), or stretch into enterprise_sales_assist (not yet validated for Northwind), activation_messaging offers the highest-confidence lever within our primary objective of sustainable revenue. Verifying memory_91 and memory_86 ensures the earlier activation and onboarding gains are still reproducible and will inform messaging approach. A standard_experiment scope allows safe iteration without broad rollout risk, preserving ability to pivot if results diverge from archived pattern.
